climbs_list.name: Alt de Sant Feliu de Codines

story: Strong winds forced organisers to shorten the stage, removing the final climb. Four riders formed the early break, but after the KOM sprints, Bouwman and Veistroffer dropped back to the peloton, leaving Kudus and Fernández out front. The duo was caught with 18 kilometres to go. A roundabout inside the final 200 metres proved decisive, with Ethan Vernon exiting it first to win the bunch sprint. Dorian Godon finished second and remained the GC leader.
